title: Starfall Reload
description: Thread dense bullet storms across three areas of a full-screen vertical shooter. Reshape four weapon families with Shot Control, graze bullets to reload bombs, and break multi-phase bosses.
requirements: Desktop browser with WebGPU support. Keyboard or standard gamepad.
screenshotAlt: Starfall Reload in Cirrus Line: the player's fighter fires a spread at the Halberd flying wing above a dawn cloud deck, with the cabinet side panels showing score, bombs and weapons.
